At the Tohoku Economic Law Study Group, I gave a research presentation as the title says. It concerns the research behind the unfinished article I presented at the Kansai Economic Law Study Group on December 3.

This was the first time I presented the substantially revised version, reflecting the comments I received at the December 3 meeting. In broad outline, I expect to finish writing the article along the lines of this presentation by March 2023.
